purpose: freeze the S1 protocol, seal the TEST examples, and rule on the G1 gate

fence.rule: no TEST row is read until the example builders are proven identical to the frozen ones
fence.enforced_by: an assertion comparing rebuilt VALIDATION counts against the frozen manifest
fence.why: a drifted builder would produce a TEST set that does not match TRAIN and VALIDATION, and nothing downstream could detect it

test_policy.why: the project gets one clean measurement on TEST and spends it on final models

gate.question: is this foundation good enough to build five learning regimes on
